title_en: On 5 Maji Street, 3+1 apartment for sale in a new building!
description_en: On 5 Maji Street, 3+1 apartment for sale in a new building! The apartment is located on the 6th floor and consists of a living room with a kitchen, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The apartment is completed for one year. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the most sought-after areas, quite quiet and with all the facilities for a comfortable life.
